title: SOLD FOR €6M. NOW REAL MADRID MAY PAY €80M TO GET HIM BACK?
description:
Six goals, eight assists in 14 club games. No wonder Madrid are reportedly interested.

Nico Paz came through Real Madrid's academy, then moved to Como in 2024. Last summer the deal was restructured and the buy-back clause rose to eighty million. That's about thirteen times the fee.

A Spanish radio report says Madrid have already decided to use it. Neither club has confirmed that. Como say he remains fully their player, and Fabregas will hope that stays true until next summer.

Chelsea, Manchester United and Arsenal are reportedly watching too. One goal contribution per game. Eighty million starts to sound like a discount.

Is Paz worth €80M, or would you walk away from that price? Your call in the comments.
